notes.title: New Graphics! (Developer's Log June 2025)
notes.content: [p]I am very pleased to announce that Lagoda Odyssey will be adopting a new 16-bit pixel art aesthetic. [/p][p][/p][p]For me, this update feels like a significant upgrade. But I'm eager to hear your opinions! [/p][p][/p][h2]The new graphic style: [/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43472721/ad1457dfd793d8922bb304ad88a9065bf38166c5.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New updated Demo!
notes.content:
There's now an updated demo of the game available for download. The new build includes various bug fixes and a redesigned level. 

If you have Lagoda Odyssey on your wishlist but don't know if you might enjoy the game. Play the demo to get an idea of how the systems work. If you don't have the game on your wishlist just yet? Oh my, check the demo and then put it on your wishlist! ;)

The new demo is around one hour long. I would also love to hear your feedback!
